title: How to learn any skill in 30 days using AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if you could master any skill in just 30 days?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing how we learn faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a system that personalizes your learning in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses advanced algorithms from companies like Duolingo and Coursera.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects anyone wanting to upskill quickly in today’s job market.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is consistency and using AI to track your progress daily.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to learn something new? Let me know what you want to master.
